answer: Each identity files a relic on the canyon ledger and stakes a 70 bond. Each epoch, three random auditors re-run the relic's work on a fresh challenge; failure burns its bond. Filing costs 42; same-root filings pile into a dune, so the k-th costs 42+6(k-1). 1,000 fakes cost 3,039,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. A rented relic cannot answer two fresh challenges. An honest agent pays 42 once and keeps a full share.
